My doctor told me a story about two patients of hers, on who was overweight and the other who was skinny. The skinny one eats vegetables every day while the overweight one is always eating pizza. The skinny one goes running regularly, while the overweight one never does. Who has had unhealthy habits recently?
A. Not known
B. The skinny person
C. The overweight person
